addr: 2nd floor, Mantri square mall, No1, Sampige Rd, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560003, India

rev.t: Purchased one fruit basket with lid stainless steel. The lid is not closing properly. Detailed video is already sent in WhatsApp. But no response till now.

While their products look very good, the upsetting part is that the quality of some of their items is sub par. I purchased a set of 3 storage glass bowls with lids in November, the lids are already beginning to break leaving me with glass …

I had a great experience shopping over the phone, Since I couldn't visit the store. Mr. Gautam shared pictures and guided me perfectly. He made the entire process seamless and hassle free. Highly recommended!
